statement: a transformation that is refused must not be admitted even when evidence is attached (sem: SEM-gx-gate-345)
why: ASM-60-1 shows evidence to a policy as `context.evidence_count` / `evidence_kinds`. ∴ if a clause of the shape 'let it through when evidence exists' gets mixed into the pack, or the mapping routes evidence into a permit-side condition, a transformation is admitted even though a forbid exists. One vector that pins the direction: 11 §4's third item (the evidence requirement) is **an added condition**, not **a reason to let through**. (sem: SEM-gx-gate-346)
spec_anchor: 11 §4 / req/38 §19 M3-07 / ASM-60-1 (req/62 §2's mapping table) (sem: SEM-gx-gate-347)

control.note: the same evidence attached to a locator in the permitted range. The control that the answer is decided by the locator, not by whether evidence is present; the day a clause requiring evidence enters the pack, this one goes red (making the shipped pack's change visible) (sem: SEM-gx-gate-348)
